notes: זֶרַע אֲנָשִׁים is rendered attributively as *a man child*, *child* for the construct and *man* for the rectum (rule 28), the indefinite article going to the construct noun; the margin's literal gloss corroborates and decides nothing (rule 38).
The negation of the last colon is recast onto the nominal as *no* and goes to לֹא (rule 15), while the presentative dummy *there* joins the finite verb (rule 17).
The infinitive absolute takes *indeed* and the finite verb keeps *thou wilt look* (rule 56); the apodosis waw takes *then* (rule 14).
